text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning a 6hr mixed k6+Locust soak for the ‘emerald’ traffic-replay tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need profiling and a short checklist before we flip the switch.
Priya: I can own flamegraphs + heap samples. What target RPS are we driving and are we replaying real prefixes?
Alex: Target ~9k steady, 12k bursts. Replay will use sampled traffic from last week with prefix-preserving enabled.
Jamal: I’ll handle k6 scenarios and the ramp schedule. Can we pin quantized model variants to avoid noisy perf deltas?
Emily: Yes please pin. Also request that we disable prefix cache for the first hour to capture cold-path metrics.
Sven: Noted — I’ll spin up a dedicated node pool (gpu-dedicated-emerald) and put a canary route that falls back to small model on overload.
Alex: Thanks. Priya, for flamegraphs do you want perf or py-spy? We have mixed Go/Python stacks.
Priya: perf for the runtime C++ paths, py-spy for Python workers. Also grab jstack for any stuck threads.
Jamal: Adding a quick checklist:
```
- warmup 15m at 2k
- ramp 30m to 9k
- 2h steady at 9k, 3x 5m bursts to 12k
- disable prefix cache first hour
- enable trace sampling 0.1% (headers: X-Trace-Sample: 0.001)
- flamegraphs every 15m
- heap samples every 30m
```
Alex: Perfect. Emily, can you attach the replay mapping and PR for the k6 scripts? I’ll need code review pings.
Emily: PR #4823 is up: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/compare/emerald-soak — please review.
Jamal: Pinged @Priya and @Sven for review in the PR. Also added a small locustfile for session-heavy flows.
Priya: Reviewing now, left a comment on the flamegraph helper script — suggest adding a timestamp suffix to avoid overwrite.
Sven: I’ll provision the pool at 01:30 UTC and pre-pull the model images. Will also open a temporary firewall rule for the replay IPs.
perf-bot: perf-alert: baseline-compare shows 4% median latency drift on the canary model since last week (investigate before long soak).
Alex: Good catch perf-bot, Jamal can you run a quick baseline AB (10m) against canary before the soak? If >3% we roll back pinned version.
Jamal: On it. Running AB now (10m). Will post results here.
Priya: Also, please ensure tracing headers are propagated to the dedicated pool and that we have sampling spans for KV cache reads.
Emily: Added KV span tags in the PR. Also uploaded example flamegraph dir to the artifacts bucket: s3://redwood-artifacts/soak/emerald/preflight-graphs/
Jamal: Baseline AB done — median +2.1%, p95 unchanged. I’ll proceed with the soak plan.
Alex: Awesome. Final: if any node reports OOM or >80% CPU on runtime, abort and notify #eng-oncall. Everyone OK with that? :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
Emily: I’ll post a short runbook on the PR and schedule a 15m async post-mortem check-in at 10:30 UTC after soak completes.
Alex: Thanks team — will send the invite and tags. Leaving this thread as the single source of truth for questions during the run.
